title: Webinar Funnel Stencil
conversionGoal: Turn interest into webinar registrations and confirm the follow-up actions after signup.
notes: Normalized from hero, agenda, speaker, proof, and registration-form patterns found across the researched template set.
Speaker credibility and agenda clarity are preserved as first-class structures because they are central to webinar conversion.
The registration surface remains a neutral form shell rather than a branded event page.

sources.notes: Confirmed the landing-page sequencing for hero, features, proof, and CTA sections.
Confirmed video- and education-style landing structures with proof, features grid, and sale CTA patterns.
Added CTA-led hero structure suitable for event registration entry surfaces.

sections.name: Hero
sections.purpose: State the webinar promise and point to registration.

sections.name: WebinarAgenda
sections.purpose: Break the session into clear agenda segments.

sections.name: TakeawayGrid
sections.purpose: Clarify what attendees will learn or leave with.

sections.name: ProofStrip
sections.purpose: Add attendee, partner, or outcome proof.

sections.name: RegistrationForm
sections.purpose: Capture registration details needed for the event.

sections.name: CTASection
sections.purpose: Repeat registration intent on the landing page.

sections.name: ConfirmationPanel
sections.purpose: Confirm webinar registration and set reminder expectations.

sections.name: NextStepPanel
sections.purpose: Route registrants into reminder, calendar, or prep actions.

pages.name: LandingPage
pages.goal: Convince visitors to register for the webinar.

pages.name: RegistrationPage
pages.goal: Capture registrant details and complete the signup.

pages.name: ConfirmationPage
pages.goal: Confirm registration and route into reminder or calendar actions.
